Post 1
📈 ASX 200 punched through a new 50-day high Tuesday, closing at 9,129.00 — up 99.30pts or 1.10%. Just 1.80% from the 52-week peak. Broad-based buying. The bulls are in control. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Industrials led all sectors at +2.31%, A-REITs close behind at +2.23%. Materials added +1.48%. Utilities and Consumer Staples were the only drags, slipping 0.38% and 0.20% respectively. #ASX #industrials #property

Post 3
MND surged +15.30% to AUD 32.63 — the session's standout. Monadelphous catching a serious bid, likely on contract momentum as Industrials dominated the tape. When the sector rips 2.31%, the contractor leads. #ASX #industrials #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,964.40/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6928. Silver at AUD 76.90/oz. Metals holding firm — supportive backdrop for ASX materials, which gained 1.48% on the day. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
9,129 is the line. ASX sits 1.80% from its 52-week high — a clean breakout or a fade at resistance. Watch gold and USD overnight. Will the index clear the record this week or stall here? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #trading
